Sustained lower? Check attribution with `/acp` or `/acp-cache` (see FAQ); usu"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"al causes, in order: upstream cache TTL expiry · model switch · a bili bug (please report) · other/u"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"es, in order: upstream cache TTL expiry · model switch · a bili bug (please report) · other/unknown."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Community"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"QQ Group:

It "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"is a living document — anyone may edit it; improvements are welcome via pull request.**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A production-scale longitudinal study: 4.5 months, three hosts, 174,327 model calls, 18.76B cumulati"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ve input tokens (~24.7B across all hosts), zero window violations on 204,800-token models, marathon "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"sessions of 8,584–12,049 calls."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 📊 Independent Third-Party Benchmarks"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **1,500-Item Cross-Benchmark Evaluation (`LongMemEval-S` · `ContextBench` · `MemoryAgentBench`)** "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"(中文版) — head-to-head comparison of `billion-context` (`v0.1.202`) against `full` context and 3 RAG a"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"rms (`bm25`, `embedding`, `embedding-rerank`) with `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`, `Qwen3-Embedding-8B`, `Qwe"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"n3-Reranker-4B`, and `Pi Agent`: **#1 on ContextBench** (`0.3097` Utilized F1, `-58.3%` cost vs `ful"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"l`), **+16.6% over best RAG on LongMemEval-S** (`79.20%` vs `62.60%`, `-71.1%` independent-session c"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ost vs `full`), and **100% survival on 1.48M-token MemoryAgentBench TTL** (`30×` steady-state compre"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ssion where `full` fails `199/199`)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`billion-context` sits between **any** agent and its model API, rewriting Anthropic/OpenAI streams w"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ith acp-kernel compression. The model decides **when** and **what** to compress into high-fidelity s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ummaries — not a hard truncation limit."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Long coding sessions blow up context. Each provider charges per token, and once you pass the context"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" window the session degrades or dies. `billion-context` compresses consumed conversation into layere"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"d summaries so you can run a single session for days — billions of tokens through one context window"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" summaries so you can run a single session for days — billions of tokens through one context window."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Unlike a host's built-in summarizer, compression here is **incremental, reversible, and prefix-cache"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" friendly**: summaries are written in small ranges, can be decompressed on demand, and the cache pre"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"aries are written in small ranges, can be decompressed on demand, and the cache prefix stays intact."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Context-management tools"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The proxy injects four context-management tools into the conversation; the model calls them itself a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s context grows, and the proxy executes `compress` server-side so folded ranges stay summarized in h"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"istory until restored:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **`compress`** — fold a message range into a detailed summary.
- **`decompress`** — restore a comp"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ressed range when exact details are needed again.
- **`search_context`** — keyword search over compr"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"essed summaries and visible messages.
- **`acp_status`** — context-usage overview plus which ranges "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"are still compressible."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Which do I need?"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Pick by your client:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Client | Use |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| **pi** | `billion-context` — `bili pi` (launcher) or `bili plugin install pi` (native); standalone"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" `billion-context-pi` remains usable — details: docs/clients.md |
| **opencode** (1.x / 2.x) | `bill"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ion-context` — `bili opencode` (launcher) or `bili plugin install opencode` (native); standalone `op"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"encode-acp` remains usable on 1.x — full guide: OpenCode |
| **omp** | `billion-context` via `bili o"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"mp` (built-in plugin) or `bili plugin install omp` (self-spawning native plugin, no launcher) |
| **"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"dsh** | `bili dsh` (launcher — full native plugin via `--patch`) or `bili plugin install dsh` ≡ `dsh"},{"id":"p27s7","text":" plugin --profile <name> add billion-context` (one unified lane) — details: docs/clients.md |
| **ki"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"mi** | `bili plugin install kimi` (self-spawning native, Kimi Code ≥ 2.0.0) or `bili kimi` (cert-MIT"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"M) or `/bili/` prefix — details: docs/clients.md |
| **hermes** | `bili plugin install hermes` (self"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"-spawning native, Python plugin #958) or `bili hermes` (cert-MITM) |
| **zcode** (Z.ai / bigmodel co"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"ding plan) | `bili plugin install zcode` (self-spawning native, #1145) or cert-MITM via the GUI's Se"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"ttings → Network or `/bili/` prefix — details: docs/clients.md |
| **claude** | `bili claude` (launc"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"her) or `bili plugin install claude` (native posture, #964 — managed settings block + session-owned "},{"id":"p27s14","text":"proxy; see the notes below) |
| **codex** | `bili codex` (launcher — the full zero-config posture) o"},{"id":"p27s15","text":"r `bili plugin install codex` (MCP-shell tools companion: **start bili first** — the shell never spa"},{"id":"p27s16","text":"wns a proxy and never routes codex's own traffic) — details: docs/clients.md |
